<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <groupId>io.exoreaction</groupId>
    <artifactId>synthesis</artifactId>
    <version>1.18.1-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <packaging>jar</packaging>

    <name>Synthesis</name>
    <description>AI operations partner for knowledge infrastructure</description>
    <url>https://github.com/exoreaction/synthesis</url>

    <scm>
        <connection>scm:git:git://github.com/exoreaction/Synthesis.git</connection>
        <developerConnection>scm:git:git@github.com:exoreaction/Synthesis.git</developerConnection>
        <url>https://github.com/exoreaction/Synthesis/tree/main</url>
        <tag>synthesis-1.10.3</tag>
    </scm>
         
         
    <properties>
        <maven.compiler.source>21</maven.compiler.source>
        <maven.compiler.target>21</maven.compiler.target>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
        <maven.build.timestamp.format>yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'</maven.build.timestamp.format>

        <!-- Dependency versions -->
        <anthropic.version>2.14.0</anthropic.version>
        <picocli.version>4.7.7</picocli.version>
        <lucene.version>10.1.0</lucene.version>
        <snakeyaml.version>2.2</snakeyaml.version>
        <pdfbox.version>3.0.4</pdfbox.version>
        <junit.version>5.11.4</junit.version>
        <lsp4j.version>0.23.1</lsp4j.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>
        <!-- CLI Framework -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>info.picocli</groupId>
            <artifactId>picocli</artifactId>
            <version>${picocli.version}</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Anthropic Claude AI SDK -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.anthropic</groupId>
            <artifactId>anthropic-java</artifactId>
            <version>${anthropic.version}</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Full-Text Search: Apache Lucene -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.lucene</groupId>
            <artifactId>lucene-core</artifactId>
            <version>${lucene.version}</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.lucene</groupId>
            <artifactId>lucene-queryparser</artifactId>
            <version>${lucene.version}</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.lucene</groupId>
            <artifactId>lucene-highlighter</artifactId>
            <version>${lucene.version}</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.lucene</groupId>
            <artifactId>lucene-analysis-common</artifactId>
            <version>${lucene.version}</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- YAML Configuration -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.yaml</groupId>
            <artifactId>snakeyaml</artifactId>
            <version>${snakeyaml.version}</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- PDF Analysis -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.pdfbox</groupId>
            <artifactId>pdfbox</artifactId>
            <version>${pdfbox.version}</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Image Metadata Extraction (EXIF, IPTC, XMP) -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.drewnoakes</groupId>
            <artifactId>metadata-extractor</artifactId>
            <version>2.19.0</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Tesseract OCR (Phase 2: LOCAL enrichment) -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>net.sourceforge.tess4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>tess4j</artifactId>
            <version>5.9.0</version>
            <exclusions>
                <!-- Exclude bundled native libs - we'll use system-installed Tesseract -->
                <exclusion>
                    <groupId>net.java.dev.jna</groupId>
                    <artifactId>jna</artifactId>
                </exclusion>
            </exclusions>
        </dependency>
        <!-- JNA for native library access -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>net.java.dev.jna</groupId>
            <artifactId>jna</artifactId>
            <version>5.14.0</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Git Integration -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.eclipse.jgit</groupId>
            <artifactId>org.eclipse.jgit</artifactId>
            <version>7.1.1.202505221757-r</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Graph Visualization: Graphviz -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>guru.nidi</groupId>
            <artifactId>graphviz-java</artifactId>
            <version>0.18.1</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Graph Algorithms -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.jgrapht</groupId>
            <artifactId>jgrapht-core</artifactId>
            <version>1.5.2</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Slack SDK for telemetry reporting -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.slack.api</groupId>
            <artifactId>slack-api-client</artifactId>
            <version>1.44.2</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- SQLite JDBC for metrics storage -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.xerial</groupId>
            <artifactId>sqlite-jdbc</artifactId>
            <version>3.47.1.0</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Flyway for database migrations -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.flywaydb</groupId>
            <artifactId>flyway-core</artifactId>
            <version>10.22.0</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- SLF4J Simple Logger (suppresses warnings) -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>slf4j-simple</artifactId>
            <version>2.0.16</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- JSON processing (for telemetry events) -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.fasterxml.jackson.core</groupId>
            <artifactId>jackson-databind</artifactId>
            <version>2.18.2</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- LSP4J - Language Server Protocol for Java -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.eclipse.lsp4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>org.eclipse.lsp4j</artifactId>
            <version>${lsp4j.version}</version>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Testing -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
            <version>${junit.version}</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>

    <build>
        <resources>
            <!-- Version properties and manifest: filtered to inject Maven version -->
            <resource>
                <directory>src/main/resources</directory>
                <filtering>true</filtering>
                <includes>
                    <include>version.properties</include>
                    <include>synthesis-manifest.json</include>
                </includes>
            </resource>
            <!-- Standard resources (not filtered, excludes binaries and version.properties) -->
            <resource>
                <directory>src/main/resources</directory>
                <filtering>false</filtering>
                <excludes>
                    <exclude>binaries/**</exclude>
                    <exclude>version.properties</exclude>
                </excludes>
            </resource>
            <!-- Binary resources (must NOT be filtered to preserve binary content) -->
            <resource>
                <directory>src/main/resources</directory>
                <filtering>false</filtering>
                <includes>
                    <include>binaries/**</include>
                </includes>
            </resource>
        </resources>
        <plugins>
            <!-- Compiler with Picocli annotation processor -->
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.13.0</version>
                <configuration>
                    <source>21</source>
                    <target>21</target>
                    <annotationProcessorPaths>
                        <path>
                            <groupId>info.picocli</groupId>
                            <artifactId>picocli-codegen</artifactId>
                            <version>${picocli.version}</version>
                        </path>
                    </annotationProcessorPaths>
                    <compilerArgs>
                        <arg>-Aproject=${project.groupId}/${project.artifactId}</arg>
                    </compilerArgs>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>

            <!-- Fat JAR with all dependencies -->
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-shade-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.6.0</version>
                <executions>
                    <!-- Main CLI JAR (synthesis.jar) -->
                    <execution>
                        <id>shade-cli</id>
                        <phase>package</phase>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>shade</goal>
                        </goals>
                        <configuration>
                            <transformers>
                                <transformer implementation="org.apache.maven.plugins.shade.resource.ManifestResourceTransformer">
                                    <mainClass>io.exoreaction.synthesis.SynthesisApp</mainClass>
                                </transformer>

Synthesis has **16 direct runtime dependencies** (plus 1 test-only) across **13 external libraries/projects**. Here's the breakdown:

---

## Direct Dependencies (16 runtime)

### Critical / Core

| Dependency | Version | Role |
|---|---|---|
| **Apache Lucene** (4 artifacts) | 10.1.0 | Full-text search engine — the heart of indexing and retrieval |
| **SQLite JDBC** (`org.xerial`) | 3.47.1.0 | All persistence: 20+ tables, knowledge graph, code graph |
| **Flyway** | 10.22.0 | Schema migration management (V1–V6, V8–V15) |
| **Anthropic Java SDK** | 2.14.0 | AI features: `ask`, `explain`, `summary`, `perspectives`, enrichment |
| **picocli** | 4.7.7 | CLI framework — all 51 subcommands, annotation processing |

### Important / Feature-enabling

| Dependency | Version | Role |
|---|---|---|
| **Eclipse JGit** | 7.1.1 | Git integration: `changelog`, `diff`, incremental code-graph, `--skip-git` |
| **Apache PDFBox** | 3.0.4 | PDF indexing and slide extraction |
| **SnakeYAML** | 2.2 | Config parsing, `.synthesis.md` identity files, YAML rule persistence |
| **Jackson Databind** | 2.18.2 | JSON (telemetry events, MCP protocol, export) |
| **JGraphT** | 1.5.2 | Graph algorithms: cycle detection, dependency analysis |
| **Graphviz-Java** (`guru.nidi`) | 0.18.1 | DOT/Mermaid rendering for architecture graphs |

### Operational / Enrichment

| Dependency | Version | Role |
|---|---|---|
| **Tess4J** (Tesseract OCR) | 5.9.0 | Local OCR enrichment for images |
| **JNA** | 5.14.0 | Native library access (used by Tess4J) |
| **metadata-extractor** (`com.drewnoakes`) | 2.19.0 | EXIF/IPTC/XMP extraction from images |
| **Slack API client** | 1.44.2 | Telemetry reporting |
| **SLF4J Simple** | 2.0.16 | Logging (suppresses noise) |
| **Eclipse LSP4J** | 0.23.1 | Language Server Protocol (LSP server JAR) |

---

## Most Critical Dependencies (what would break without them)

1. **Lucene** — remove it and search, indexing, and all retrieval stops entirely. Every other feature depends on it.
2. **SQLite JDBC + Flyway** — remove these and all persistence (knowledge graph, code graph, metrics, routing feedback, snapshots) is gone.
3. **picocli** — the entire CLI collapses; no commands work.
4. **Anthropic SDK** — all AI features (`ask`, `explain`, `summary`, `perspectives`, enrichment) stop. Core indexing/search still works.
5. **JGit** — `changelog`, `diff`, incremental code-graph updates, and `--skip-git` fallback all break.

---

## Repository Note

Synthesis publishes to and resolves from a **Cantara Maven repository** (`mvnrepo.cantara.no`) in addition to Maven Central. The Anthropic Java SDK (`com.anthropic:anthropic-java`) is likely the dependency most likely to come from there rather than Central.
